author: shadowolfyt
body:
Hello Everyone
Some of you are asking where has Avicus Map Overviews gone! Well due to me being at college and such its really hard to do 3 videos a week BUT I am going to be doing some Avicus Map Overviews this week just wondering what maps in particular would you like to see? The maps that I have already done are posted here.

I will be on Avicus some time this week recording Avicus Map Overviews so be sure to come on and say hi!
